records.rule: All seven Phase 2D values are protected patient data; NOK and address are restricted contact/location data.
No raw NOK name, phone, high-cardinality relationship, address, identifying occupation, PAT_ID or OPD appears in repository, prompts, logs, screenshots or aggregate evidence.
Repository evidence contains aggregate counts and approved nonidentifying allow-list categories only.
Operational diagnostics use domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 with environment secret, key version, canonicalization version and length-prefixed typed messages.

records.scope: religion/marital provenance with typed field discriminator

records.rule: Never compare HMACs across domains, environments, keys or canonicalization versions.
Every child retains PATIENT-PRIV-007 patient-root token and protected source/target crosswalk provenance; PAT_ID remains absent from routine artifacts.
Existing-target comparisons retain only protected flags/tokens; no source or target raw value is emitted.
Migration audit records run, contract versions, classification, transformation, exception and reconciliation facts without false operational activity.
